units.source_text: 匂亲王一方面对二女公子深感抱歉，但他原是好色之徒，一方面又想尽力讨好正在等他的新人，便兴致勃勃地打扮，

en.t: Prince Niou felt deeply sorry toward the Second Princess, but he was by nature a man of amorous tastes; at the same time, wanting to do his utmost to please the new bride who was waiting for him, he dressed himself with great enthusiasm,

units.source_text: 浑身薰足了异常馥郁的衣香，姿态之艳丽不可言喻。

en.t: perfuming his whole body with an unusually rich fragrance of incense in his robes, and his radiant elegance was beyond words.

units.source_text: 六条院中等候新婿上门，排场之体面更不待言。

en.t: At Rokujo-in they were waiting for the new son-in-law to arrive, and the dignity and splendor of the arrangements need hardly be mentioned.

units.source_text: 匂亲王起初担心：“听说六女公子身体并不小巧纤弱，而是相当壮健的。

en.t: At first Prince Niou worried, saying, “I hear that the Sixth Princess is not small and delicate in build, but rather quite sturdy.
But what is she really like?

units.source_text: 会不会大模大样、粗心粗思、毫无温柔之情而一味倚势凌人呢？

en.t: Could she be overbearing and careless, coarse in thought, with no tenderness at all, simply relying on her position to dominate others?

units.source_text: 如果这样，倒是煞风景了。”

en.t: If so, that would be terribly disappointing.”

units.source_text: 但见面之后，大概他并不觉得如此，所以对她恩爱很重。

en.t: After meeting her, however, he apparently did not feel that way, and so he showed her very deep affection.

units.source_text: 秋夜虽已较长，但因他来时已经更深，故不久天就亮了。

en.t: Although autumn nights had already grown longer, it was already very late when he arrived, so before long dawn broke.
